description: Variation of condition 3 (approved plans) to allow the relocation of the backup generator and cycle store of block G of planning permission 00676/88/P2 approved 08/07/2016 for the hybrid application for demolition of existing buildings, to include a Full application for:- 178 residential dwellings (C3 use), flexible uses including retail (A1 use) or cafe (A3 use) or community centre (D1 use), car parking, public space, landscaping and associated works; and an Outline application for:- up to 762 residential dwellings (C3 use) and associated car parking, public space, landscaping and associated works, with all matters to be reserved except means of access.

Condition : 2 - Phase 1
The development of Phase 1 hereby approved shall be begun no later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission reference 00676/88/P2 dated 08/07/2016. 
Condition : 3 - Drawings

1018_2QA_Phase1_Units_rev1-P01, 1018_2QA_Phase1_GIA_rev1-P01, 1018_2QA_Phase1_NIA_Block A_rev1-P01, 
Condition : 4 - Reserved Matters
Application for approval of the reserved matters for the Outline elements shall be made to the Local Planning Authority before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission reference 00676/88/P2 dated 08/07/2016.
Condition : 5 - Phase 2
The development of the outline element hereby permitted shall be begun either before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission reference 00676/88/P2 dated 08/07/2016, or before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the reserved matters reference 00676/88/P3 dated 14/10/2020, whichever is the later.
Condition : 6 - Approval of Reserved Matters
Approval of the details of the layout, scale, appearance and landscaping of the site (hereinafter called the "Reserved Matters") for the Outline elements, reference 00676/88/P3 dated 14/10/2020, shall be obtained from the Local Planning Authority in writing before any development of Phase 2 (excluding demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys or other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of ant temporary means of enclosure and land raising) is commenced. 
Condition : 7 - Maximum parameters 
The outline element hereby granted approval and any subsequent Reserved Matters shall not exceed the maximum parameters with regards to footprint, height, floor space, use, volume and location of public space, highways and car parking as shown on the approved plans:
Parameter Plans Ref: 1018_00_07_010, 1018_00_07_011, 1018_00_07_012, 1018_00_07_013, 1018_00_07_014_P02, 1018_00_07_015_P02, 1018_00_07_016_P02, 1018_00_07_017_P02, 1018_00_07_018_P02, 1018_00_07_019_P02, 1018_00_07_020_P02
Condition : 8 - In accordance with London Plan Housing SPG
All dwellings that form part of the outline element hereby granted approval shall be designed in accordance with the London Plan draft Housing SPG (2015), or such other adopted guidance in place at the time of submission of the Reserved Matters.
Condition : 9 - Construction hours 
No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am to 6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 4pm on Saturdays and not at all on Sundays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 10 - Construction and Phasing 
The development hereby approved shall be implemented in strict accordance with the construction and phasing programmes approved under application references 00676/88/P2(10) dated 22/02/2017 for Phase 1 and 00676/88/P2(10,53) approved 19 January 2021 and 00676/88/P3(10-12) dated 26 October 2021 for Phase 2. 
Condition : 11 - Phase 1 CLP
All construction and demolition works associated with Phase 1 shall be undertaken in accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) hereby approved.
Condition : 12 - Phase 2 CLP
The development hereby approved shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Construction Logistics Plan (CLP) approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(10-12) dated 26 October 2021. 
Condition : 13 - Waste & Recycling
(A).	The storage and collection of waste of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details approved under applications reference 00676/88/P2(13A) dated 16 March 2017 and 00676/88/P2(13) dated 09 July 2021. 
(B).	No Block shall be occupied until the waste and recycling facilities approved under Part (A) of this condition have been provided and made available for use by residents of that Block. Such facilities shall remain throughout the lifetime of the development and shall be used for no other purposes.
Condition : 14 - Materials 
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details of facing materials for Phase 1 approved under application references 00676/88/P2(14) dated 26 April 2017; for Block B approved under 00676/88/P2(14i) dated 16 May 2017; for Mansion blocks A and B approved under 00676/88/P2(14ii) dated 15 September 2017; for Phase 2 approved under 00676/88/P3(14) dated 28 June 2021, 00676/88/P3(14i) dated 09 September 2021 and 00676/88/P3(14ii) dated 15 February 2022; for Block G approved under 00676/88/P2(14iii) dated 09 January 2023; for Blocks C West, D East, D West, E and F approved under 00676/88/P2(14-36) dated 12 June 2023 and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 15 - M4(2) Building Regulations
Each residential unit shall meet M4(2) Building Regulations as shown on the hereby approved plans with the exception of those within the retained building known as 88 Lampton Road (Core B5), which shall meet Part M4(1) 'Visitable dwellings'.
Condition : 16 - Wheelchair Housing Units
A minimum 10% 'Wheelchair User Dwellings' built to Building Regulations M4(3) standard shall be provided. This shall include a minimum of 18 units provided within Phase 1 of the hereby approved development.
Condition : 17 - Residential Design Codes
The scheme shall be constructed in accordance with the principles of the design codes as referred to in the Design and Access Statement (Chapter 4, 5 and 6) prepared by Allies and Morrison.
Condition : 18 - Acoustic Design Strategy
Phase 1 of the hereby approved development shall only be carried out in in strict accordance with the acoustic insulation and means of ventilation details and as per the evidence submitted under approved application references 00676/88/P2(18A) dated 20 March 2017 and 00676/88/P2(18B) dated 19 November 2018. 
Block B of the hereby approved development shall only be carried out in in strict accordance with the acoustic insulation and means of ventilation details and as per the evidence submitted under approved application references 00676/88/P3(18A-32) dated 09 June 2021 and 00676/88/P2(18Bi) dated 23 December 2022.
All other blocks in Phase 2 of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in in strict accordance with the acoustic insulation and means of ventilation details submitted under approved application references approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(18A-32) dated 09 June 2021. 
For all other Blocks/Phases:  (B) Prior to any other Block of the development being occupied, the internal ambient noise levels shall be tested against the existing background noise levels at the date of this decision to demonstrate compliance by that Block with the scheme approved under Part A of this condition and shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 19 - Water Consumption
The hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved internal water use calculations as demonstrated under application reference 00676/88/P2(19) dated 19 March 2018 for Phase 1 and approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(19) dated 01 August 2022 Phase 2  . 
Condition : 20 - Drainage
The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the detailed drainage designs for Phase 1 approved under applications reference 00676/88/P2(20,23) dated 22 March 2017; for Blocks B, C East and G approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(20i, 23i) dated 14 December 2021; for Block E approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(20i-36i) dated 24 May 2023; for Block F approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(14-36) dated 12 June 2023; and for Block D West approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(20ii-36ii) dated 24 July 2023.
For all other blocks: prior to commencement of each Block (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), details of:
- drainage designs (including drawings) which demonstrate that surface water runoff from the site will be restricted to a rate of no greater than 66.9 l/s for storm events of up to and including 1 in 100 year (plus climate change) return periods. This should also demonstrate the sustainable drainage system features proposed in the December 2015 Flood Risk Assessment and the 17th February 2016 Addendum Letter will be constructed to provide the necessary attenuation. This will thereby reduce the risk of surface water flooding to and from the site and increase the water quality, biodiversity and amenity benefits through the use of rainwater harvesting and above ground features, including permeable paving wherever possible; and
- a management plan(s) for the routine maintenance of the development's drainage system for all of the above and below-ground drainage features, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such measures shall be implemented and maintained 
Condition : 21 - Water Supply Impact Study (Thames Water)
The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the submitted details of the water impact study and recommendations contained therein approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(21) dated 08 February 2017. Any mitigation measures identified in the studies shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the development.
Condition : 22 - Piling Method Statement
Any piling must be undertaken in accordance with the terms of the approved piling method statements approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(22) dated 08 February 2017 for Phase 1 and under application reference 00676/88/P3(18A-32) dated 09 June 2021 for Phase 2. 
Condition : 23 - Waste Water Infrastructure
The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the detailed drainage designs for Phase 1 approved under applications reference 00676/88/P2(20,23) dated 22 March 2017; for Blocks B, C East and G approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(20i, 23i) dated 14 December 2021; for Block E approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(20i-36i) dated 24 May 2023; for Block F approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(14-36) dated 12 June 2023; and for Block D West approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(20ii-36ii) dated 24 July 2023. 
For all other blocks: development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of a Block shall not commence until a drainage strategy detailing any on and/or off site drainage works, has been submitted to and approved by, the Local Planning Authority (in consultation with the sewerage undertaker). No discharge of foul or surface water from the site shall be accepted into the public system until the drainage works referred to in the strategy have been completed for the relevant phase.
No discharge of foul or surface water from the site shall be accepted into the public system until the drainage works referred to in the strategy have been completed for the relevant phase.
Condition : 24 - Archaeological Works
The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the details of the archaeological Stage 1 Written Scheme of Investigation (WSI) approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(24) dated 21 October 2016 and the a Stage 2 WSI under application reference 00676/88/P2(24i) 07 February 2018. 
Condition : 25 - Phased Contamination
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details and validation (closure) reports submitted under application references 00676/88/P2(25A,B) dated 13 February 2017, 00676/88/P2(25C) dated 18 July 2017, 00676/88/P2(25Ci,D) dated 19 November 2018, and 00676/88/P2(25Ai-D) dated 26 January 2023. 
Condition : 26 - Phase 1 compliance with Energy Strategy
The hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and as per the evidence submitted under application references 00676/88/P2(26) dated 01 August 2018, 00676/88/P2(26i) dated 23 November 2018, and 00676/88/P2(26iii) dated 26 June 2019
Condition : 27 - Phase 2 Energy Strategy
Phase 2 of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved Energy Strategy submitted under application reference 00676/88/P3(27A) dated 01 June 2021. 
Block B of the hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and as per the evidence submitted under application reference 00676/88/P2(27-29B) dated 22 December 2022.
For all other blocks: (B). Prior to the occupation of any Block within the outline element Prior to the occupation of any unit within Phase 2 of the development, evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of installation contracts) to demonstrate that the development of that Phase has been carried out in accordance with the approved energy strategy (Part (A)), and a reduction in CO2 emissions has been achieved in accordance with the energy strategy approved, shall be submitted to and approved in writing, by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 28 - District Heat Network
Phase 1 of the hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved district heat network details and as per the evidence submitted under application references 00676/88/P2(28A) dated 09 January 2017 for Phase 1 and 00676/88/P2(28B) dated 17 May 2018 Phase 1 Block A and B. 
Block B of the hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the approved district heat network details and as per the evidence submitted under application reference 00676/88/P2(27-29B) dated 22 December 2022.
All other blocks in Phase 2 of the hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the approved district heat network details submitted under application reference 00676/88/P3(28A) dated 30 April 2021. 
For all other Blocks/Phases: B). No Block of the development shall be occupied until evidence demonstrating that the approved scheme under Part (A) of this condition has been implemented, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved design details and no alterations shall take place without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 29 - Sustainable Construction
Phase 1 of the hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the sustainable sourcing of materials details and as per the evidence approved under application references 00676/88/P2(29A-32) dated 15 February 2017 and 00676/88/P2(29B) dated 06 April 2018. 
Block B of the hereby approved development shall be maintained in accordance with the sustainable sourcing of materials details and as per the evidence approved under application references 00676/88/P3(29A) dated 30 April 2021 and 00676/88/P2(27-29B) dated 22 December 2022 for Block B.
The hereby approved development shall be built in accordance with the sustainable sourcing of materials details approved under application references 00676/88/P3(29A) dated 30 April 2021 for Blocks C East and G and 00676/88/P2(14-36) dated 12 June 2023 for Blocks C West, D East, D West, and E. 
For all other Blocks/Phases: (A) No development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until details for that Block have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority demonstrating that: 
- At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) Green Guide to Specification; 
- At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme; and 
- No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, inc
Condition : 30 - Tree Protection Plan
The hereby approved development shall only be carried out in strict accordance with the details of the Tree Protection Plans approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(30) dated 12 December 2016 for Phase 1 and approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(18A-32) dated 09 June 2021 for Phase 2.
Condition : 31 - Landscaping
The hard and soft landscaping of the hereby approved development shall be carried out and managed for the lifetime of the development in strict accordance with the details and management programme for Phase 1 approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(29A-32) dated 15 February 2017; for Block B, Block G and Block C East, and the site wide landscape infrastructure for the entirety of Phase 2 approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(31) dated 11 August 2021; for Block D approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(31) dated 12 October 2022; for Block F approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(31i) 05 December 2022; and for Block E approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(31ii) dated 14 February 2023.
For all other Blocks, Prior to the commencement of any above ground level works (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising), details of both hard and soft landscape works for that Block shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The works shall then be carried out as approved.  
The detailed landscaping scheme shall include:  
- soft planting: including any grass and turf areas, trees, planters, shrub and herbaceous areas including details of species, sizes, numbers/densities and sections of landscaped areas; 
- a 'Tree Planting Statement' providing full details, locations, specifications and construction methods for all purpose-built tree pits and associated above ground features, including specifications for tree protection and a stated volume of suitable growing medium to facilitate and promote the healthy development of the proposed trees, ensuring each tree has a soil volume equivalent of 0.6 times its canopy area 
Condition : 32 - Ecology
The development hereby approved shall be carried out in strict accordance with the Biodiversity Enhancement Strategies approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(29A-32) dated 15 February 2017 for Phase 1  and approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(18A-32) dated 09 June 2021 for Phase 2. Any enhancement measures shall be maintained throughout the lifetime of the development or in accordance with the strategy set out in the Ecological Management Plan.
Condition : 33 - Delivery & Servicing Plan (non-residential)
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in accordance with the Delivery & Servicing Plan for the non-residential use at 88 Lampton Road approved under application 00676/88/P2(33,34) dated 24 October 2018. 
Condition : 34 - Car Park Management Plan
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in accordance with the Car Park Management Plan approved under application 00676/88/P2(33,34) dated 24 October 2018 for Phase 1 and approved under application 00676/88/P3(34) dated 08 July 2022 for Phase 2. The car park management plan shall then be implemented as approved and remain in operation thereafter.
Condition : 35 - Cycle storage
Prior to the occupation of any unit within a Block (of Phase 1), any residential cycle storage for that Block shall be made available for use in accordance with the provision indicated on the approved plans, with the exception of cycle stores associated with Blocks A and B which shall be redesigned and constructed so as not to accommodate more than 50 stands per store. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all residents and where double stack arrangements, these shall be provided with a mechanical or pneumatic assisted lift (or such equivalent provision). The cycle stores shall then be maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 36 - Phase 2 cycle storage
Cycle storage shall be provided for Blocks B, C east and G in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00676/88/P3(36) dated 21 July 2021; for Block E in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00676/88/P2(20i-36i) dated 24 May 2023; and for Block F in accordance with the approved details of application reference 00676/88/P2(14-36) dated 12 June 2023. 
For all other Blocks, details of the layout, design and appearance (shown in context) of the bicycle storage area(s) for each Block within the outline element, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to the development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) of Phase 2. This storage shall consist of a horizontal storage arrangement to ensure accessibility for all residents and where double stack arrangements these shall be provided with a mechanical or pneumatic assisted lift (or such equivalent provision).
The bicycle storage area(s) shall be provided strictly in accordance with the details so approved and shall be provided/erected prior to the first occupation of any part of that Phase, and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 37 - Parking, loading, turning spaces
Prior to the first occupation of a Block, the parking, loading and turning spaces for that Block as set out in the approved plans, shall be constructed and made available for use. The parking, loading and turning spaces shall then be retained as such and shall not be used for any other purposes thereafter.
Condition : 38 - Vehicular Access points
Prior to the first occupation of a Block, the means of pedestrian and vehicular access for that Block hereby approved shall be constructed in accordance with the approved plans and made available for use and any redundant access points shall be closed with the re-instatement of kerbs and footway.
Condition : 39 - Highway works
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in accordance with the detailed highways works approved under application reference00676/88/P2(39) dated 08 February 2017 for Phase 1 and approved under application reference 00676/88/P3(39) dated 16 November 2021 for Phase 2. 
Condition : 40 - Pedestrian visibility splays
Pedestrian visibility splays as shown on the approved plans either side of the vehicular accesses on Lampton Road shall be provided prior to first occupation of the development and maintained as such thereafter with nothing over 600mm in these regions.
Condition : 41 - Entry & exit signage
Entry and exit signage corresponding to the appropriate vehicle access shall be provided prior to occupation of any part of the development and maintained as such thereafter.
Condition : 42 - Height Limitation on Buildings and Structures
No building or structure of the development hereby permitted shall exceed 87m Above Ordnance Datum (AOD).
Condition : 43 - Control of Lighting
The development is close to the aerodrome and/or aircraft taking off from or landing at the aerodrome.  Lighting schemes required during construction and for the completed development shall be of a flat glass, full cut off design, mounted horizontally or below the horizontal, and shall ensure that there is no light spill above the horizontal.
Condition : 44 - Bird hazard management plan
Phase 1 of the hereby approved development shall be managed in strict accordance with the approved Bird Hazard Management Plan approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(44) dated 16 January 2017.
For all other Phases/Blocks, no development (except demolition, archaeological investigations, ground condition investigations and intrusive site surveys and other enabling works: site clearance; soil storage; remedial works in respect of any contamination or any other adverse ground conditions; erection of any temporary means of enclosure and land raising) shall take place on any Block until a Bird Hazard Management Plan in respect of the buildings within that Block has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted plan shall include details of: 
- management of any flat/shallow pitched/green roofs on buildings within the site which may be attractive to nesting, roosting and loafing birds. The management plan shall comply with Advice Note 8 Potential Bird Hazard from Building Design. 
The Bird Hazard Management Plan shall then be implemented in accordance with the approved details on completion of development of that phase and shall remain in force for the life of the development.
Condition : 45 - Odour mitigation (for any subsequent A3 use)
Prior to the commencement of any A3 use within the development, a scheme for the control of noise, fumes and odours for that unit, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and a detailed assessment of the effectiveness of the scheme, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall then be implemented as approved before the use of the relevant unit commences and shall be retained as such thereafter.
Condition : 46 - External Plant
The hereby approved development shall be managed in strict accordance with the submitted details of external ventilation equipment approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(46) dated 05 July 2018 for Phase 1 and approved under application reference 00676/88/P2(46i) dated 22 December 2022 for Phase 2.
Condition : 47 - Restriction on permitted development rights - boundary treatments
Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no fences, gates or walls shall be erected within the curtilage of any dwellinghouse forward of any wall of that dwellinghouse which fronts onto a road.
Condition : 48 - Restriction on permitted development rights - additional windows
Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no windows/dormer windows other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be constructed or installed.
Condition : 49 - Restriction on permitted development rights - extensions/additions
Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no enlargement of the premises or any additional structures/buildings other than those expressly authorised by this permission shall be shall be carried out.
Condition : 50 - Restriction on hours of use
Any A1/A3 uses hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times: 8:00am to 11:00pm Monday to Saturday, 10:00am to 11:00pm Sundays, Bank Holidays and Public Holidays.
Condition : 51 - Restriction on hours of delivery for A1/A3 use
No deliveries to any A1 or A3 use shall be taken at or dispatched from the site outside the hours of 07.00 hours to 18.00 hours Monday to Saturday nor outside the hours of 09.00 hours to 14.00 hours on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.
Condition : 52 - Restriction on external noise - A3 use
No amplified or other music played in or from the Class A3 use shall be audible within the nearest residential unit.
Condition : 53 - Phasing Plan 
The hereby approved development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the phasing plan approved under application 00676/88/P2(10,53) dated 19 January 2021. 
Condition : 54 - Noise Assessment
The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the generator to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142.  An alternative position for assessment /measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved.
